note: Sourced from free public primary sources per exchange (see sources[]): CBK Kenya (T-bills/T-bonds), CBN Nigeria (NTB JSON), CBE Egypt (T-bills/T-bonds/sukuk), plus the worldgovernmentbonds.com constant-maturity sovereign curve for all four. This is a periodic snapshot dated per row, not a live feed. Rows the source publishes without a date are marked undated with the reason. No free source publishing corporate-bond yields or per-ISIN JSE R-bond prices was reachable, so none is shown for those; the pre-existing curated instruments that could not be confirmed are carried forward as unconfirmed.
